scripts.dev: npm --workspace @atelier/contracts run build && concurrently -k -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm --workspace @atelier/contracts run build && npm --workspace @atelier/server run build && npm --workspace @atelier/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace @atelier/contracts run build && npm --workspace @atelier/server run typecheck && npm --workspace @atelier/web run typecheck
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm --workspace @atelier/desktop run dev
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && npm --workspace @atelier/desktop run build
